decision: LLM actors are permitted to perform annotator_a, annotator_b, adjudicator, independent_blind_reviewer, and source_reviewer roles for Stage1-v2 annotation assets, under the constraints below. This creates an explicit llm_annotation_track; it does not redefine or relax any human-track semantics.

constraints.independence_requirement: annotator_a and annotator_b outputs MUST be produced by separate model contexts that share no reasoning state and never see each other's outputs; the adjudicator runs in a third independent context and sees raw A/B only for disagreement items; the blind reviewer runs in a fourth independent context and sees no A/B/adjudicated labels.
constraints.answer_key_isolation: qualification_answer_key_private.jsonl and any blinding maps must never be read by annotator/adjudicator/blind-reviewer contexts.
constraints.agreement_semantics_caveat: A/B agreement under this track measures cross-context self-consistency of one model family, not human inter-annotator agreement; correlated model errors are not detectable by these gates.
constraints.paper_disclosure_required: any downstream report or paper must label assets produced under this amendment as LLM-annotated (stage1-v2-llm-annotation-amendment-v1); they must not be presented as human annotation evidence.
constraints.human_upgrade_path: human annotators may later re-verify samples; only human-verified rows may set human_verified=true, at which point the asset may be promoted out of the llm track.

gate_effects.required_atomic_sources_human_verified: NOT_satisfiable_by_llm_review; remains false until real human verification
gate_effects.formal_ready: remains false while any human-named gate is unsatisfied; this amendment does not create a bypass

notes: Motivation: human staffing is unavailable; the project owner directed data completion via LLM annotation with per-item strict review.
The prior Stage1-v1 downgrade was caused by absent annotation-quality evidence; this amendment records actor provenance explicitly so the evidence tier of every produced asset is unambiguous.
codex_stage1_v2_reviewer is grandfathered for the existing source-review sidecar batch 0001.
